title: Accurate Panchang & a calmer, steadier app
titleHi: सटीक पंचांग और अधिक स्थिर ऐप

highlights.title: Panchang now uses true Sun & Moon positions
highlights.titleHi: पंचांग अब वास्तविक सूर्य-चंद्र स्थिति से
highlights.text: Sidereal zodiac with Lahiri ayanamsa, so nakshatra, yoga and rashi now match traditional panchangs (for example, Shravana on 16 Nov 2026).

highlights.title: Background Om chant keeps playing
highlights.titleHi: पृष्ठभूमि ॐ जप चलता रहता है
highlights.text: The ambient chant no longer stops when you switch screens. It resumes after a mantra ends, and changing the volume doesn't restart it.

highlights.title: Smoother navigation
highlights.text: Screens fade in, Back works correctly across tool tabs, and the Japa and Mala tiles on Home open the counter directly.

more: Mitra links like 'View Daily Panchang' now open the right screen
YouTube links work with bare video IDs
Clearer messages when a link can't open
Safer database upgrades (no crash on update)

title: Video Hub, Temple Finder & guest mode
titleHi: वीडियो हब, मंदिर खोज और अतिथि मोड

highlights.title: Sacred Video Hub
highlights.text: Darshan, aarti and katha from curated YouTube channels, with festival specials and favourites.

highlights.title: Temple Finder
highlights.text: A directory of sacred mandirs by city and deity, with distance, story and directions.

highlights.title: Guest mode
highlights.text: Use japa, Panchang, meditation and the library without an account.

more: Knowledge Hub filters by deity, difficulty and format
